description: Writes an amount in Brazilian reais in words, in Brazilian Portuguese, the way it appears on receipts (1500,50 becomes "mil e quinhentos reais e cinquenta centavos"). Accepts 0 to 999.999.999,99. Stores nothing.

valor.description: Valor em reais: número (1500.5) ou texto ("1.500,50").
